title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-17

ai_review.summary: Muffled audience‑recorded tape of a standout acoustic show – acoustic Box of Rain, Dark Star and Truckin' shine despite the poor sound.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its rare acoustic set, highlighted by an unforgettable acoustic Box of Rain and a powerful Dark Star.  However, reviewers repeatedly note that the recording is badly muffled, with heavy audience bleed and a lack of clarity, making it a mixed‑quality listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality consistently rated high (≈4.5/5) while recording quality is low (≈2.5/5); weighted combination yields ~3.9 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Muffled, almost “mic wrapped in a shirt” sound; heavy audience chatter and little instrument separation make details hard to hear, though some listeners find the lo‑fi character interesting.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The acoustic portion dominates and is praised for its intimacy; tape cuts and occasional rough transitions are noted, but overall the set flows well with strong jams and memorable vocal harmonies.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Acoustic piano and pedal‑steel work highlighted; his presence on guitar noted positively.
band_member_comments.Phil: Vocals on Box of Rain praised; also contributes acoustic guitar in the acoustic set.
